required_gates: sellable capability is verified by runtime evidence
$1000 revenue experiment has a measured sandbox result
no release-blocking build or deployment failure
owner explicitly enables live monetization for that bot/offer
truth_boundary: Passing tests can make a bot eligible for live monetization, but it does not authorize spending, outreach, contracts, refunds, payouts or charges beyond the owner's configured live permissions. Revenue is recorded only from verified Stripe events, never from forecasts or simulations.
